figures.title: Bar + observations
figures.caption: Synthetic data; n = 10 independent units per group. Bars: mean; error bars: sample SD; all 40 observations shown. Horizontal jitter only, seed 42.

figures.title: Box + observations
figures.caption: Same synthetic data as 01. Boxes: median and hinges; whiskers: most extreme observations within 1.5 x IQR. All observations shown once by the point layer.

figures.title: Paired change
figures.caption: Synthetic paired measurements for 12 individuals. Each grey line joins the same individual; fixed identical horizontal offsets preserve pairing. No hypothesis test.

figures.title: Longitudinal trajectories
figures.caption: Synthetic data: 10 individuals/group, visits at 0, 2, 5 and 8 days. Thin lines: individuals; thick lines: group means; bands: descriptive mean +/- SD. L13 at day 5 is missing and its trajectory retains a gap. N by visit is in longitudinal_summary.csv.

figures.title: Nested observations
figures.caption: Synthetic data: 4 independent animals/group, 6 fields/animal. Small circles: fields; large circles: animal means; dashed line: mean of the four animal means in that group. Panels separate groups. No hypothesis test.

figures.title: Dose-response curve
figures.caption: Synthetic independent measurements: 6 per positive concentration. Curve: four-parameter logistic nls fit; band: approximate 95% CI for the mean using the delta method and residual t quantile. No prediction interval or extrapolation. Fitted parameters/curve saved separately.

figures.title: Forest plot
figures.caption: Directly supplied synthetic adjusted risk ratios and 95% confidence limits; no regression fitted. Ratio axis is logarithmic, null reference = 1. Row labels and numeric intervals correspond to the saved result table.

figures.title: Kaplan-Meier curve
figures.caption: Synthetic right-censored single-event data, 60 individuals/group, common time zero; maximum follow-up 12 months. Curves: Kaplan-Meier; bands: log-log 95% CI; + marks: censoring. Risk table: time >= each displayed time. No group-comparison test.

figures.title: Competing-risk cumulative incidence
figures.caption: Synthetic data: 80 individuals/group; target outcome and competing death are absorbing first events, with right censoring and a common time zero. Curves: Aalen-Johansen target-event probability; bands: pointwise plain 95% CI (bounded to [0,1] by survival). Risk table counts those free of both events and uncensored immediately before each displayed time. No test or regression.

figures.title: Volcano plot
figures.caption: Synthetic 600-gene result table; constructed two-sided P values are BH-adjusted within the example. DEG display: adjusted P < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1. Labels: union of top 4 per direction by adjusted P and absolute log2FC, ties by stable keys. No display capping or label cherry-picking.

figures.title: Annotated row-Z heatmap
figures.caption: Synthetic transformed measurement matrix: 20 genes x 12 samples, 4/group. Values standardized within each row (sample SD); gene rows clustered by Euclidean distance and complete linkage. Samples retain group order. Symmetric colour limits cover all values; Z-scores encode within-gene variation, not between-gene abundance.

figures.title: ORA dot plot
figures.caption: Illustrative synthetic GO biological-process-style ORA result table; no enrichment test is run and no GO identifiers are assigned. All 9 illustrative terms are shown in adjusted-P order. Ratio = count / 120 submitted genes. BP only; CC/MF and GSEA were not simulated. Values describe no biological discovery.
